name: The First Resurrection
overview: The First Resurrection is a powerful biblical truth that assures believers of a future awakening from the grave, as foretold in Isaiah 26:19 and Daniel 12:2, where the dead arise to everlasting life. This resurrection is closely linked to the redemptive work of Christ, whose death and resurrection paved the way for this hope (Matthew 20:18; Matthew 27:52; Matthew 28:5). John 5:28 emphasizes that all who are in their graves will hear Christ’s voice, underscoring His authority over life and death and the certainty of this resurrection event.
